sparkling-row-eight-session1-r446-202610.scope: Isolated 8-versus-16 SIMD dispatch with otherwise identical checked Ada library sources, adopted native O3/LTO/FP-contraction-off flags, against the pinned source-built normal AVX/LTO C3.17 reference. Numerical oracle remains the official C3.17 wheel; no parity or promotion claim.
limitations: Both current Ada and source-built C use known GCC16 native O3/FP-contraction-off/LTO settings; baseline Ada has LTO off. Supported-workload diagnostic; full gates and port scope remain pending.
Smooth Euler only: no contacts, constraints, sensors or rendering.
The raw shared mass reader is not on this stepping path.
Bootstrap is within-session without multiple-comparison correction; p95 is trajectory mean, not individual step latency.
